backlog.spec: Make sure the whole train step, including the optimizer step, is not recompiling. Mark dynamic=False in torch.compile of the model. Keep it simple, and report the step count to check that throughput does not drop.

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). In a fixed 300 s budget this doubles optimizer steps. Leave all LRs unchanged. If the code scales anything by batch size, keep it consistent.

backlog.spec: Raise EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9 and UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 in one run. This tests whether the Adam-trained embedding groups are under-trained in a short run. No other changes.

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 85 so model_dim rounds to 512 (a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128). The smaller model fits more steps in 300 s. Keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 and the other hyperparameters unchanged.

backlog.spec: In the window-size computation, change the short window S from half of the sequence length to a quarter of it. Keep the last layer at full context and the SSSL pattern. This reduces attention cost and may allow more steps. No other changes.

backlog.spec: In the Muon momentum schedule, after the warmup to 0.95, ramp momentum linearly from 0.95 to 0.97 during the warmdown phase of the time-based progress. Leave the rest unchanged.

backlog.spec: Find the logit softcap constant used before the loss (probably 15) and set it to 30. This tests whether a weaker cap helps the loss in a short run. No other changes.

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**17 (about 131K tokens per optimizer step) so there are roughly twice as many optimizer steps in the 300 s budget. Leave all other hyperparameters unchanged. Make sure gradient accumulation is computed as TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE // (DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE * MAX_SEQ_LEN) and is at least 1. If it would come out below 1, lower DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32.
backlog.title: Batch 2**17 with depth 6

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH to 5 and ASPECT_RATIO to 103 so model_dim rounds up to 512 (4 heads at HEAD_DIM 128). This gives a smaller, faster model that gets more steps in 300 s. Keep WINDOW_PATTERN as is. If the pattern logic requires it, make sure the final layer is still a full-attention layer.

backlog.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06. Short training with a small model may favor a more aggressive Muon step size. Change nothing else.

backlog.spec: Change the MLP hidden dimension from 4*n_embd to 3*n_embd (the c_fc output and c_proj input). This lowers the parameter count and FLOPs per step, giving more steps in 300 s. Keep the ReLU squared activation and zero-init c_proj. Change nothing else.

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 so the LR ramps linearly from 0 to its peak over the first 3 percent of the time budget. This tests whether it reduces early instability at the high Adam LRs. Keep the warmdown ratio and the other settings the same.

backlog.spec: Change the short-window size from half the context to one eighth of MAX_SEQ_LEN (sequence length // 8) for the S layers in WINDOW_PATTERN. The L layers stay full context. Make sure the last layer is still L. This reduces attention cost and may allow more steps in 300 s.
backlog.title: Sliding window shorter: 1/8 context for S layers

backlog.spec: Change the logit softcap constant from 15 to 30 in the forward pass (logits = softcap * tanh(logits / softcap)). Change nothing else.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 30

backlog.spec: Set ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.99) for the embedding, unembedding and scalar Adam groups. Smoother moment estimates may help at the smaller batch size. Change nothing else.
